thread:
emma_ml: FYI I've kicked off a conversion job for valkyrie-13b -> safetensors, tp=4 shards, fp16. Need a quick serve-readiness pass before we push to staging.
raj_serving: thanks — where are the weights and what's the shard filename pattern? also need checksum.
emma_ml: s3://redwood-models/valkyrie/valkyrie-13b/v1/
emma_ml: shard pattern: valkyrie-13b.tp4.rank{0..3}.safetensors (we used rank0..rank3). sha256: 3b2f7a9d8c9e4f2b6a1c5d9e8f3b7c1d2e4f6a7b9c8d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b
lina_infra: quick infra note — TP4 expects kv shard ordering consistent with our serving runtime (tensor_parallel_axis == 1). please include tensor_parallel_size: 4 in model_config.json, and ensure kv_shard_order: ["layer","rank"] if you used layer-major packing.
sam_platform: pinging for a fast CR on the convert script PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/3421 :eyes:
kevin_ops: heads-up on tokenizer: upstream tokenizer doesn't have eos token set (we saw odd truncation at generation). add "eos_token_id": 2 to tokenizer_config.json or map to existing token id. also verify pad token mapping.
emma_ml: noted about eos. I patched tokenizer_config before conversion — commit abc123 in the conversion repo. snippet:
```
{"eos_token_id": 2, "pad_token_id": 0}
```
emma_ml: also observed fp16 instability on longer seqs (4096) in a small perf run — two samples had NaN in the lm_head. wondering if we should fallback to bf16 for final staging bundle.
raj_serving: run the layer-norm + fp check: `python tools/validate_fp.py --model /staging/valkyrie-13b --dtype fp16 --check-layers` — if that fails, bf16 for staging makes sense. also run `pytest -k "serve_smoke" -q` after conversion to validate kv-cache and streaming.
deploy-bot: staging-convert-job-558 queued (submitted by emma_ml). logs: https://ci.internal/logs/convert/558 :white_check_mark:
sam_platform: I'll review the PR in ~30m. If all good, tag for canary rollout 1% and I'll trigger a dedicated staging run. :thumbsup:
emma_ml: checklist for ourselves:
- [ ] verify sha256 for all ranks
- [ ] confirm tokenizer_config (eos/pad)
- [ ] add tensor_parallel_size and kv_shard_order to model_config.json
- [ ] run validate_fp.py + serve_smoke tests
- [ ] get PR review and merge
- [ ] canary 1% staging rollout
lina_infra: small infra action: open firewall for staging agents to pull from the s3 gateway (allow 10.1.32.0/24 -> s3-gw.redwood.internal). I'll create the rule and tag ops.
kevin_ops: also question on metadata: do we flag this model as "allows-personal-data=false" in model_card? if not, we should add privacy flags before making it public in hosted catalog.
emma_ml: good call — set model_card.privacy: "restricted" for now. I'll add it in the conversion manifest.
raj_serving: once smoke passes, can we do a shadow traffic pass (mirror 5% of requests) before canary? helps catch runtime mismatch between shard layout and serving optimizations.
sam_platform: yes, we'll do shadow 5% -> canary 1% -> ramp if everything is green. I'll put the rollout steps in the PR description.
emma_ml: thanks everyone — will post logs once convert job finishes and ping again. :rocket:
